header.title: Muse UFO-C
header.description: Executable source-derived UFO-C intentional, action, commitment, claim, social-relator, role and normative package.

definition.text: An event intentionally performed by an agent under an intention.
A specialization of agent participation used to represent action contribution in UFO-C.
A type whose instances are action entities as characterized in UFO-C.
A substantial capable of intentional action.
A type whose instances are agent entities as characterized in UFO-C.
A specialization of commitment used to represent appointment in UFO-C.
A specialization of goal used to represent appointment goal in UFO-C.
An atomic event that is an action.
A commitment whose bearer is bound by the atomic content or role specified in UFO-C.
A mental moment whose propositional content is accepted as true.
A social situation representing a state of affairs in which claim conditions obtain.
A commitment whose bearer is bound by the closed content or role specified in UFO-C.
A social agent constituted by multiple agents.
An intentional or social moment binding an agent toward content.
A social situation representing a state of affairs in which commitment conditions obtain.
An atomic action that communicates propositional or normative content.
A complex event intentionally performed by an agent.
A commitment whose bearer is bound by the complex content or role specified in UFO-C.
A specialization of material relation used to represent delegation in UFO-C.
A specialization of social relator used to represent delegatum in UFO-C.
A mental moment whose propositional content is desired.
A specialization of normative description used to represent directive in UFO-C.
A proposition functioning as the content of an intention.
notes: Goal is role-like relative to an intention.

definition.text: A institutional agent recognized as capable of bearing or exercising the agency associated with institution in UFO-C.
A communicative act representing the occurrence of institutional act in UFO-C.
A social agent recognized by an institution or normative system.
An internal commitment directed toward a goal.
An intrinsic moment directed toward propositional content.
A complex action involving multiple agents.
A commitment whose bearer is bound by the internal content or role specified in UFO-C.
A specialization of material relationship type used to represent material relation in UFO-C.
An intentional moment borne by an agent.
A social object describing norms, rules, or expected conduct.
A specialization of proposition used to represent normative proposition in UFO-C.
A specialization of social object used to represent normative system in UFO-C.
A commitment whose bearer is bound by the open content or role specified in UFO-C.
An agent with a physical bearer.
A specialization of object used to represent physical object in UFO-C.
A normative description specifying an intended course of action.
A specialization of normative description used to represent policy in UFO-C.
The abstract content of an intentional moment or communicative act.
A social agent recognized as capable of bearing or exercising the agency associated with recognized agent in UFO-C.
A specialization of object used to represent resource in UFO-C.
An event part representing the participation of a resource participant in an event.
A specialization of normative description used to represent rule in UFO-C.
An agent constituted through social or institutional structure.
A social moment inhering in a creditor and correlated with a social commitment.
A commitment inhering in a debtor and externally depending on a creditor.
A qua individual grounded in a social relation.
An object whose existence or identity depends on social recognition.
A relator composed of mutually dependent social commitments and claims.
A role defined through participation in a social relation or institution.
An anti-rigid non-sortal whose instances play a common relational role in UFO-C.
A type whose instances are social role entities as characterized in UFO-C.
A situation representing a state of affairs in which social conditions obtain.
A collective social agent recognized as capable of bearing or exercising the agency associated with society in UFO-C.

ufo:aimsAt.definition: Relates an intention or action to a goal.

ufo:assignsRole.definition: Holds from a institution to a social role when the source assigns role the target, as defined in UFO-C.

ufo:bearsIntentionalMoment.definition: Holds from a agent to a intentional moment when the source bears intentional moment the target, as defined in UFO-C.

ufo:claimAgainst.definition: Holds from a social claim to a agent when the source has claim against the target, as defined in UFO-C.

ufo:claimHolder.definition: Holds from a social claim to a agent when the source has claim holder the target, as defined in UFO-C.

ufo:composesSocialRelator.definition: Holds from a social moment to a social relator when the source composes social relator the target, as defined in UFO-C.

ufo:contributesToAction.definition: Holds from a action contribution to a action when the source contributes to action the target, as defined in UFO-C.

ufo:createsSocialRelator.definition: Holds from a institutional act to a social relator when the source creates social relator the target, as defined in UFO-C.

ufo:delegatesGoal.definition: Holds from a delegatum to a goal when the source delegates goal the target, as defined in UFO-C.

ufo:delegatesTo.definition: Holds from a agent to a agent when the source delegates to the target, as defined in UFO-C.

ufo:expresses.definition: Holds from a communicative act to a proposition when the source expresses the target, as defined in UFO-C.

ufo:fulfillsCommitment.definition: Holds from a action to a commitment when the source fulfills commitment the target, as defined in UFO-C.

ufo:governedBy.definition: Holds from a institution to a normative description when the source is governed by the target, as defined in UFO-C.

ufo:hasContent.definition: Relates an intentional moment or communicative act to propositional content.

ufo:hasCreditor.definition: Holds from a social commitment to a agent when the source has creditor the target, as defined in UFO-C.

ufo:hasDebtor.definition: Holds from a social commitment to a agent when the source has debtor the target, as defined in UFO-C.

ufo:intentionalMomentInheresIn.definition: Holds from a intentional moment to a agent when the source intentional moment inheres in the target, as defined in UFO-C.

ufo:isCorrelativeOf.definition: Relates a social claim and social commitment with shared content and reciprocal dependence.

ufo:mediatesSocialAgent.definition: Holds from a social relator to a agent when the source mediates social agent the target, as defined in UFO-C.

ufo:modifiesSocialRelator.definition: Holds from a institutional act to a social relator when the source modifies social relator the target, as defined in UFO-C.

ufo:motivatedBy.definition: Relates an action to an intention directing it.

ufo:performs.definition: Relates an agent to an action it performs.

ufo:recognizedBy.definition: Holds from a social object to a institution when the source is recognized by the target, as defined in UFO-C.

ufo:terminatesSocialRelator.definition: Holds from a institutional act to a social relator when the source terminates social relator the target, as defined in UFO-C.

ufo:usesResource.definition: Holds from a action to a resource when the source uses resource the target, as defined in UFO-C.

ufo:violatesCommitment.definition: Holds from a action to a commitment when the source violates commitment the target, as defined in UFO-C.
